name: Fukami Kaori
source:
A 3rd year student at Kirigaoka Gakuin High School. Although Kaori has a headstrong and active personality, she often feels lonely. She is an idol who works under the stage name "Mitsuki Konoha". Kaori is worried about her future path since her popularity as an idol has decreased and she gets less work offers. 

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
